decision_basis: DKK4/KREMEN2 interaction with KREMEN2-dependent Wnt/LRP6 inhibition and structural support for DKK/Kremen/LRP5/6 complex regulation support qualified-high context-dependent receptor-complex relay/function evidence; no universal terminal-TF claim is made.

DKK4/LRP6 co-immunoprecipitation and LRP6-linked beta-catenin suppression with fibroblast stress-fiber/myofibroblast and colorectal-cancer metastatic outputs support qualified-high exact coreceptor relay/function evidence in the defined stromal cancer models.
